hook: → 观点卡：AI 资本开支泡沫与宏观利率约束
lines: Ruchir Sharma argues that the AI bubble is showing signs of exhaustion due to rising interest rates and increased government competition for capital.

The guest highlights that the heavy global capital concentration in the US reflects a lack of alternative options rather than pure confidence, driven by China's structural over-investment and regulatory uncertainty.

Sharma points out that India has emerged as an 'anti-AI' trade with negative correlation to the sector, while stressing that long-term investment success depends more on emotional temperament than technical analysis.
podcast: In Good Company with Nicolai Tangen
title: Ruchir Sharma: Why the World Is Betting on America and Predictions for 2027
